adc_j_per_conversion.label: ESTIMATE

array_n.label: DESIGN CHOICE
array_n.source: array dimension N (N x N tiles)

gpu_flop_per_weight_row.label: STANDARD
gpu_flop_per_weight_row.source: forward 2 + input-gradient 2 + weight-gradient 2 FLOP per weight per row

h100_bf16_dense_flops.label: SPEC
h100_bf16_dense_flops.source: NVIDIA H100 page: BF16 tensor 1,979 TFLOPS with sparsity, i.e. 989.5 dense [nvidiah100]

h100_mfu.label: MEASURED
h100_mfu.source: Llama 3 405B pre-training on 8K-16K H100s: BF16 MFU 38-43 % (380-430 TFLOPs/GPU) [dubey2024]

h100_power_w.label: SPEC (range: ESTIMATE of sustained draw)
h100_power_w.source: NVIDIA H100 product page: max TDP up to 700 W (SXM) [nvidiah100]; low end ESTIMATE

line_cap_f_per_cell.label: ESTIMATE

mvm_mac_per_weight_row.label: STANDARD
mvm_mac_per_weight_row.source: one forward and one backward (transpose) read

mvm_tops_per_w.label: MEASURED (central, low) / PROJECTION (high)
mvm_tops_per_w.source: 12.4 TOPS/W chip-sustained, 14 nm PCM analog-AI chip [ambrogio2023]; 9.76 TOPS/W for 8-bit MVMs, 64-core PCM chip [legallo2023]; 84,000 GOPS/s/W projected RPU system [gokmen2016]

rng_j_per_slot.label: ESTIMATE
rng_j_per_slot.source: one stochastic bit per line per pulse slot (an LFSR plus a comparator; ours)

slots_bl.label: SIM
slots_bl.source: pulse slots per row (the simulator's BL)

sram_add_j.label: ESTIMATE
sram_add_j.source: one read-add-write of the 16-32 bit buffer H per read weight (ours; cf. [horowitz2014])

note: central: measured PCM-chip MVM efficiency + central estimates; range: every input at its low/high end (the analog pessimistic total against the GPU's best case, and the reverse)
